name: argentina-payroll
description: Use this Guide for Argentine employee income-tax withholding in fiscal year 2026: Ganancias cuarta categoria, relacion de dependencia, retenciones de sueldos, SiRADIG, F.572 Web and F.1359. It covers the withholding agent, cumulative computation, SAC, personal deductions, multiple employers, annual and final settlements, the ordinary withholding ceiling, reporting fields and refunds. It distinguishes January-June and July-December payroll tables from the annual settlement tables. It prepares working papers for a local professional to review. It does not calculate labour-law entitlements, employer social contributions, pensioner special deductions, executive termination packages or non-resident withholding.
